[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:381YE Winter]]
__NOTOC__
<ic>Motion: Under the premise that the Imperial Constitution is not intended to disadvantage the Empire, this motion creates the Senate power of Escalation.<br>
When an election is announced in Senate, the proposing Senator may call for escalation, the motion will subsequently become a Constitutional motion and the election will be immediately triggered.<br>
Any senator on the senate floor may propose a candidate (including in absentia), however for a candidate to be appointed they just receive the support of a constitutional majority (including ratification from the Throne.)<br>
Should no candidates be elected, a new motion to appoint would need to be submitted.<br><br><i>Proposed Weirwater, seconded Morrow. </i></ic>
==Overview==
* To grant the Senate a new power, that of escalation.
* This was a constitutional vote.
* Passed with constitutional majority.
* Ratified by [[the Throne]].
==Date==
* Winter 381YE
==Campaign Outcome==
* The new power of [[Appointment_by_the_Senate#Escalation|escalation]] was created.
